name: Ziba
bio: Ziba was a servant of Saul's household whom David summoned to ask if anyone of Saul's line remained, so that he might show them kindness for Jonathan's sake. Ziba told David of Jonathan's crippled son Mephibosheth, living in Lo-debar in the house of Machir son of Ammiel (2 Samuel 9:1-4). After David restored to Mephibosheth all the land that had belonged to Saul, he put Ziba — who had fifteen sons and twenty servants of his own — in charge of farming that land on Mephibosheth's behalf, so that Mephibosheth could eat at the king's table (2 Samuel 9:9-12). Ziba's complicated loyalty to Mephibosheth resurfaces later during Absalom's rebellion, a story told in detail in the chapters ahead.
